articles.title: Advent to Sell Prisma and Newpay to Visa
articles.mainIdea: Advent to Sell Prisma and Newpay to Visa
articles.summary: Business Wire: Advent to Sell Prisma and Newpay to Visa. SÃO PAULO & BUENOS AIRES, Argentina, February 19, 2026--Advent International, a leading global private equity investor, today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to sell Prisma and Newpay, subsidiaries of Group Prisma, a leading Argentine payments company, to Visa (NYSE: V).

articles.title: Visa to Acquire Prisma Medios de Pago and Newpay in Argentina
articles.mainIdea: Visa to Acquire Prisma Medios de Pago and Newpay in Argentina
articles.summary: Business Wire: Visa to Acquire Prisma Medios de Pago and Newpay in Argentina. BUENOS AIRES, Argentina, February 19, 2026--Visa (NYSE: V) today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Prisma Medios de Pago S.A.U. ("Prisma") and Newpay S.A.U. ("Newpay") in Argentina from Advent International. This strategic acquisition underscores Visa’s commitment to providing clients with the advanced capabilities and technologies that accelerate the adoption of innovative payment solutions for consumers and businesses across the country.
